name: Customer Reference 1
definition: Contains customer reference values provided for this transaction and used for various reference processing at the|customer site. These values represent information most prevalently provided by travel agencies for transactions booked against a lodged account or central travel account.

Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Defines the content of the value provided in the Customer Reference detail.

Detail.name: Detail
Detail.definition: Subfield is a free-form text field containing customer reference value details about the transaction.
